record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Related to Fixed Point Properties
record.context_brief: Reverse implications among fixed point properties
record.original_question: For a semitopological semigroup S, consider the fixed point properties (fppw), (fppwq), (fppwe), and (fppQ), where the paper states the implication chain fppw => fppwq => fppwe => fppQ. Can any of these implications be reversed?

evidence.quote: (fppw) Whenever S acts on a weakly compact convex subset K of a separated locally convex space (E, Q) and the action is weakly separately continuous and Q-nonexpansive, then K contains a common fixed point for S.

(fppwq) Whenever S acts on a weakly compact convex subset K of a separated locally convex space (E, Q) and the action is weakly separately continu￾ous, weakly quasi-equicontinuous and Q-nonexpansive, then K contains a common fixed point for S.

(fppwe) Whenever S acts on a weakly compact convex subset K of a separated locally convex space (E, Q) and the action is weakly separately continuous, weakly equicontinuous and Q-nonexpansive, then K contains a common fixed point for S.
(fppQ) Whenever S acts on a compact convex subset K of a separated lo￾cally convex space (E, Q) and the action is separately continuous and Q￾nonexpansive, then K contains a common fixed point for S.
Clearly, we have the implication relations fppw ⇒ fppwq ⇒ fppwe ⇒ fppQ.
Problem 2.8. Can any of the above implications be reversed?

artifact.status_search_result: A web search located related work on Q-nonexpansive actions of semitopological semigroups on weakly compact convex sets in locally convex spaces (e.g., Lau–Zhang type results and "Fixed Point Properties and Q-Nonexpansive Retractions in Locally Convex Spaces"), but no source was found that establishes or refutes the reverse implications among (fppw), (fppwq), (fppwe), (fppQ). The status of these reverse implications appears to remain unresolved in the literature accessed.

status_evidence.title: Fixed Point Properties and Q-Nonexpansive Retractions in Locally Convex Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies fixed point properties for semitopological semigroups acting Q-nonexpansively on weakly compact convex subsets of separated locally convex spaces, the same framework in which (fppw), (fppwq), (fppwe), (fppQ) are formulated.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the framework underlying the four properties but does not settle the reverse implications.

status_evidence.title: Fixed point properties for semigroups of nonlinear mappings and amenability
status_evidence.snippet: Studies relationships between various fixed point properties for semitopological semigroups and amenability conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Related general theory; does not directly compare (fppw), (fppwq), (fppwe), (fppQ) in a way that reverses the chain.
